summary.description: 1-3 sentences: what the change does and the overall view.

path.description: Repo-relative path, or null for a General finding.

start_line.description: First line of a multi-line range, else null.

line.description: Line number in the file version given by side; null for a General finding.

side.description: RIGHT = new file (added/context lines), LEFT = old file (deleted lines).

suggestion.description: Replacement text for lines start_line..line on RIGHT, at most ~5 lines, else null.
